seo_title: EEAT SEO & Structured Data for B2B Companies | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Prove your authority to Google. We implement entity architecture and advanced Schema markup to rank your company above your competitors.
author_pitch: I have seen elite engineering firms and consultancies lose clients to rookies simply because Google didn't trust their website. I apply advanced data markup to transform your site into an entity of unquestionable authority, proving to the algorithm that you are the true experts.
title: Earn Google's trust: Entity Authority and B2B EEAT
body:
Do you offer high-level B2B services but Google ranks competitors with less experience above you?

In demanding sectors like engineering, healthcare, or industrial consulting, publishing good texts is not enough. Google's algorithm defaults to distrusting any new or poorly structured website. If search engines cannot connect your team's experts with their real-world reputation, your domain will never reach top positions. You are losing million-dollar contracts simply because your digital platform does not project the same credibility and trust as your physical company.

The trap of Junk Links and Anonymous Content

Buying hundreds of low-quality links or publishing unsigned articles no longer works; in fact, it triggers the search engine's spam alarms. Google does not rank web pages, it ranks entities that can prove their real-world experience in an industry.

Our solution: Schema Code Injection and EEAT Protocol

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we turn your platform into a highly trusted digital asset. We apply data engineering to translate your professional track record into the exact language read by Google's robots.

  1. Structured Data Markup (Schema): We inject invisible code into your website that unambiguously explains to Google who you are, what you sell, and what corporate awards or certifications back you up.
  2. Expert Author Linking: We connect your team's biographies with their LinkedIn profiles, academic publications, and press mentions to validate their level of specialization.
  3. Topical Cluster Architecture: We reorganize your content into perfect semantic silos to demonstrate exhaustive and profound mastery over the key areas of your sector.
  4. Trust Signals Consolidation: We align your legal information, service policies, and verified reviews to maximize EEAT (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness) metrics.

The Real Impact on your Corporate Ranking

  • Top Rankings Unlocked: By dispelling the algorithm's doubts, your website receives an immediate boost that allows you to surpass historically stronger competitors.
  • Premium Client Attraction: A high-authority profile attracts executives and decision-makers who are only looking to hire the absolute leaders in the market.
  • Rich Results Appearance: Your company begins to stand out on Google with special information boxes, star ratings, and Knowledge Graph profiles.
